decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-31 | Results, not activity (the owner, 2026-10-31 rework: "Quero que o Faber de resultados reais mesmo em vez de só ficar gastando cota e enganando o usuario"). What a conversation delivered and what it cost is derived from its stored messages every time and never kept as a second copy that a rewind or an edit could leave wrong (`engine/src/results.rs`, `tally`): distinct files an editing tool changed, checks run and how they ended, commits, pull requests, files made for the person, answers to the person's own messages (a turn Faber sent by itself is never an answer), and whether the last closing box says done; against tokens, API-priced cost per vendor, work time and span. Of 3,652 stored replies 1,037 reported neither a price nor tokens, so a conversation's cost says "at least" when any turn did (`cost.unpriced`); what a rewind took away is not counted, and a project's totals add its conversations' (a file two of them changed counts twice). Quota is a share of a window Faber learns per vendor (`learn.rs`) and is not recorded per conversation, so cost is shown as API-price worth, which moves with it. The conversation list carries the numbers (`Summary.results`), so a project reads them without opening a conversation; the commands `results` and `project_results` give them to the screen, the command line and the AI. A command run through a shell (a patch applied from PowerShell) does not count as an edit; the tools' own edits, commits Faber recognises and passed checks do. | Erick |
